### 1 — Scene
A vegetable salad with rocket/arugula, asparagus, grilled eggplant and pale cubes that appear to be tofu.

### 2 — Vessel
A large, shallow square dinner plate, approximately **27 cm across**. Using the requested circular approximation:  
**Area = 3.14 × 13.5² ≈ 572 cm².**

### 3 — Items
Rocket/mixed leaves, asparagus spears, grilled eggplant, tofu cubes and a light oil dressing suggested by the glossy vegetables.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy
Area shares below partition the visible food footprint rather than double-counting overlapping ingredients.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Rocket/mixed leaves | 30% | 172 cm² × 2 cm = 344 ml | 0.15 | 52 g | 25 | 13 kcal |
| Asparagus | 10% | 57 cm² × 1.6 cm = 91 ml | 0.65 | 59 g | 22 | 13 kcal |
| Grilled eggplant | 13% | 74 cm² × 2 cm = 148 ml | 0.60 | 89 g | 35 | 31 kcal |
| Tofu cubes | 7% | 40 cm² × 1.8 cm = 72 ml | 1.0 | 72 g | 120 | 86 kcal |
| Oil dressing | Overlapping sheen | Approximately 6 ml | 0.92 | 6 g | 884 | 53 kcal |

**Food coverage: 60% total.** Oil coats the ingredients and adds no separate footprint.

### 8 — Sanity check
Estimated total: **278 g and 196 kcal**. This is plausible for a loosely piled vegetable salad with several tofu cubes and substantial empty plate space. The main uncertainties are the identity of the cubes and the amount of oil.
